summary: This page of the Starhill Global REIT annual report serves as an overview introducing the entity's strategy, mission, values, portfolio composition across nine locations (valued at S\$2.8 billion), and management structure by YTL Starhill Global REIT Management Limited. The contents table outlines subsequent sections including key highlights, property portfolios, financial summaries, and governance details, with no audited Portfolio Statement, financial tables, or tenant mix data present on this specific page.

This page presents SG$ million financial highlights for the SGX REIT reporting unit, featuring a main table of key metrics including S$192.1 Million gross revenue, S$87.8 Million income available for distribution, 94.6% occupancy, and 3.65 Cents distribution per unit as at 30 June 2025.

This page presents key corporate events for FY 2024/25, including reported distributions (DPU) of 1.85 cents for 2H FY 2023/24 and 3.63 cents for the full year, alongside issuances of RM500 million senior notes by Ara Bintang Berhad and bank facility agreements totaling S$125 million. No financial tables such as audited portfolio statements, profit or loss reports, tenant mix data, or management information are present on this page.

This page presents the SGX'000 reporting unit's financial highlights including a Gearing Ratio of 36.0%, Interest Coverage Ratio of 2.9x, and Weighted Average Debt Maturity of 3.1 years as at 30 June 2025, alongside details on opportunistic capital recycling where 13 strata units in Wisma Atria Property (Office) were divested to leave a 68.81% group interest. The content also features corporate rating information with a "BBB" credit rating affirmed by Fitch Ratings and descriptions of unsecured sustainability-linked club debt facilities totaling S$600 million obtained in March 2025.

This page presents a Quality Tenant Profile with key portfolio metrics including 94.6% occupancy, a long weighted average lease expiry of 7.6 years (7.5 years by GRI), and master/anchor lease details for Toshin and Katagreen as at 30 June 2025. It also reports on the UNIQLO expansion in Myer Centre Adelaide to a double-storey duplex scheduled for completion by end 2025.

This page details Starhill Global REIT's geographical portfolio across six Asia-Pacific cities with nine properties, featuring a table by asset value and gross revenue for Singapore (S$1,944.4 Million / S$120.0 Million) and Australia (S$331.9 Million / S$40.1 Million), along with the master/anchor lease contribution of 52.6% to gross rental income.

This page presents a top-N assets table for the SGX REIT's Malaysia, Japan, and China portfolio segments as of 30 June 2025, listing key properties like The Starhill Kuala Lumpur with their square footage, asset value (in S$ Million), gross revenue (FY 2024/25 in S$ Million), location, ownership percentage, property type, and notes on composition.

This page presents SGREIT's five-year financial highlights for FY 2024/25, featuring tables on gross revenue ($S\$ million), net property income ($S\$ million), income available for distribution ($S\$ million), and distribution per unit (cents). It also includes asset values (Total Assets at S\$2,846.2 million as of June 2025) and occupancy rates (%).

This page presents the Statement of Total Return and Distribution for the Year alongside a Balance Sheet as at 30 June 2025, reporting key financial highlights in SGD million. The summary details FY 2024/25 gross revenue of S$192.1 million, distribution per unit (DPU) of 3.65 cents, and asset values including total assets of S$2,846.2 million and investment property valuations of S$2,755.8 million across nine properties.

This page presents Starhill Global REIT's trading performance and total return data for the period from 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025, featuring a table of monthly volume traded ('000 units) and closing unit prices (S$), alongside summary statistics for opening/closing/high/low prices and annual returns. The main artifact is a table displaying the one-year total return (13.4%), distribution yield (7.2%), and comparable three- and five-year figures in S$, with notes clarifying that DPU calculations are based on the closing price of S$0.510 per unit as at 30 June 2025.

This page of the Starhill Global REIT annual report for FY 2024/25 (SGD'000) serves as a Letter to Unitholders, presenting DPU financial highlights with a growth of 0.6% y-o-y to 3.65 cents and a total return of 13.4%, alongside gross revenue and net property income figures expressed in SGD millions. The section details portfolio resilience through Singapore Properties and Perth Properties, outlines key lease renewals such as the Toshin master lease at Ngee Ann City, and identifies management leadership including Chairman Tan Sri (Sir) Francis Yeoh and CEO Mr Ho Sing.

This page presents the audited Portfolio Statement (property valuations) for SGX REIT as of 30 June 2025, detailing nine properties with their locations, descriptions, net lettable areas (NLA), titles, tenant counts, and purchase prices reported in S$ million. The report includes a trade/tenant mix breakdown per asset, noting specific retail and office square footage along with leasehold or freehold tenure details and acquisition dates where applicable.

This page presents a Valuation and Revenue table for the SGX REIT's portfolio as of 30 June 2025, reporting asset values in S$ million alongside occupancy rates and FY 2024/25 revenue figures (S$ million) for major tenants including DBS Treasures Centre, Ebisu Fort, Katagreen, and Family Mart. The data includes property valuations, tenant mix details with specific brand lists, and revenue comparisons against the prior year, with footnotes clarifying exchange rate conversions for foreign assets and acquisition history.

This page presents SGX REIT's property portfolio summary, featuring tables detailing Gross Revenue by Country and Segment for FY 2024/25 (reported in percentages) alongside Portfolio Committed Occupancy levels as of 30 June 2025 and 30 June 2024. It also includes information on master and anchor tenants such as Toshin Development Singapore Pte. Ltd., Katagreen Development Sdn. Bhd., Myer Pty Ltd, and David Jones Pty Limited, which collectively account for approximately 52.6% of gross rental income.

This page presents the Top 10 Tenants table showing SGREIT's major tenants as of 30 June 2025, with Toshin Development Singapore Pte. Ltd. contributing 23.8% and YTL Group 15.6% to the portfolio's Gross Rental Income (GRI), alongside a detailed Portfolio Trade Mix by GRI chart. The reporting unit is explicitly stated as percentages of total portfolio GRI, and no audited Portfolio Statement, financial highlights, or manager/trustee information are present on this page.

This page features the main artifact, a "Property Portfolio Summary" displaying weighted average lease term expiry data via bar charts and tables for the Group's Singapore, Australia, and total portfolios across fiscal years FY 25/26 to Beyond FY 28/29. It also includes text-based summaries of shopper traffic trends at the Wisma Atria property and details on the divestment of 13 strata units (approx. 18,546 sq ft) generating S$41 million in FY 2024/25, all reported in SGD'000 or S$ million where applicable.

This page presents a **Statement of Portfolio (property valuations)** titled "Property Portfolio Summary," detailing the valuation of six property categories—Ngee Ann City Property, Wisma Atria Property, Australia Properties, Malaysia Properties, Japan Property, and China Property—in **S$ million** from Sep '05 to Jun '25. The data includes historical trend analysis via a stacked bar chart and a comparative table showing year-over-year changes as at 30 June 2025, with footnotes specifying foreign currency translation rates.

The portfolio comprises 57.1% freehold and 42.9% leasehold properties totaling S\$2,754.6 million, broken down by location including Ngee Ann City Property, Australia Properties, Malaysia Properties (The Starhill), Japan Property, and China Property, with specific valuations and year-over-year changes provided for each segment.

This page presents a property profile for Ngee Ann City, including its market valuation of SGD 1,160.0 Million (as at 30 June 2025), leasehold tenure details, and a tenant mix breakdown showing retail tenants contributed 76.4% while office tenants contributed 23.6% of gross revenue; it explicitly names the master tenant Toshin as accounting for 86.1% of retail gross revenue and lists key anchor tenants such as Takashimaya, Lululemon, and Louis Vuitton.

Ltd., The Great Room NA Pte. Ltd., Cortina Holdings Limited, Beauty One International, and DBS Bank Ltd.

This page presents a narrative description of the Wisma Atria Property, including its physical attributes, tenant mix details (noting Burberry and The Awfully Chocolate Experience Café), and FY 2024/25 revenue composition where retail tenants contributed 80.1% and office tenants 19.9%, without providing any audited Portfolio Statement, financial tables, or specific reporting unit values.

This page details the David Jones Building asset, including its freehold tenure, S$104.7 million market valuation, and 99.3% committed occupancy as at 30 June 2025, alongside a Top-N tenants table listing five entities by Gross Lettable Area (GRI) and a Retail Trade Mix chart showing David Jones accounts for 86.3% of GRI.

This page details the Starhill property, an integrated development with 162 luxury rooms and a total net lettable area of 333,289 sq ft as at 30 June 2025, reporting a market valuation of S$281.7 million and 100% occupancy rate for both retail and hotel components.
